cost: DECLINED ON THE NUMBER, AND THE FRONTIER IS THE ROUND'S REAL OUTPUT. His word after recal_140 was "Suns dont have to be 85, but can be heigher, low 70s"; the dispatch read that as team:offdial 72 +-3, i.e. >= 69. The Suns '05 read 66 and read 68. 315 settings of (CREATE_SHARE, TOV_SIZE, AMP_MAX) were graded on all 1,255 fieldable fives, each with FEED_REF re-derived on the pool and the OFF gauge re-frozen exactly as scripts/gauge105.ts freezes it (scripts/sweep143.ts, grid143.ts, hunt143.ts, ridge143.ts, front143.ts). THE FRONTIER, bound by bound: with EVERY pin held the maximum is 68 (unrounded 68.4 at share 0.40 / tov 0.68 / amp 0.28) · with the Celtics '24 team-OFF rank bound dropped, 69 · with the summit ORDER dropped as well, 72-73 (share 0.6-0.8, tov 1.0-1.3) AND THE FIT RISES to .7803-.7829 · with the Bulls '96 OFF dial dropped too, 76-77 · with nothing held at all, 79 at fit .7513. THE LOW 70s ARE REACHABLE AND THEY ARE NOT EXPENSIVE IN FIT — they are expensive in the SUMMIT ORDER. That is the one sentence a later round needs.

WHAT ACTUALLY BLOCKS 69, stated flat so it is not re-measured. Two walls, and they pull in opposite directions. (1) CREATE_SHARE: a pass-through pays fives with ONE dominant distributor and taxes fives with five middling ones. The Celtics '24 have no dominant creator, so they slide — 9th of 26 at 0.20, 10th at 0.30, 11th at 0.38, 12th at 0.40, 13th at 0.45 — and recal_119's team-OFF rank <=10 binds at 0.30-0.40. (2) TOV_SIZE: the possession channel pays BALL SECURITY, and the Warriors '17 are the least secure of the all-time top four (real TOV% 14.4) while the Celtics '88 are among the most. Their gap on the all-time adjusted index closes at ~0.385 points per unit of TOV_SIZE: 0.384 behind at 0.45, 0.073 behind at 0.66, PAST at 0.72. Every cell that reaches 69 crosses one wall or the other. The Bulls '96 OFF dial is the third wall and it is now ON its ceiling at 71 of recal_105's 68 +-3, because they too are a secure five.

THE TWO CONSTANTS WERE CHOSEN AS A PAIR AND NEITHER ALONE MOVES THE SUBJECT. CREATE_SHARE alone (tov held at 0.45) breaks the Celtics '24 rank at 0.25 and never leaves the subject at 66-67. TOV_SIZE alone (share held at 0.20) breaks the Bulls '96 OFF dial at 0.65 and never leaves the subject above 66. Only together do they clear a ridge: the share pulls the Bulls DOWN (their feed is the pool's widest, so a pass-through compresses their edge) while the tov pushes them up, and the share pushes the Celtics '24 down while the tov pulls them up. 0.30 / 0.66 sits on that ridge with the widest remaining summit margin (0.073 index points) of any cell that reads 68.

THE OFF GAUGE WAS RE-FROZEN AND THE DEF BLOCK WAS NOT TOUCHED. All 1,255 offRaw moved, so scripts/gauge105.ts was re-run. OFF_MIN 101.05 -> 100.47, OFF_MID 121.76 -> 121.67, OFF_TOP 138.39 -> 138.18, OFF_LEVEL_REF 121.8003 -> 121.7882, and the 47-season OFF_LEVEL table by hundredths. The decade mean DEF dial is unchanged to a tenth in all five eras (51.3 / 51.3 / 51.4 / 51.3 / 51.0).

REJECTED, each measured on all 1,255 fives. (1) CREATE_SHARE ALONE at its largest pin-holding value — recal_140's lever (a). On the pipeline-142 pool it is DEAD: 0.25 already puts the Celtics '24 11th. recal_140 measured 0.50 -> 70 with only the Bulls rank as casualty; that was the pipeline-140 pool, and after recal_135/141/142 moved the cards it is no longer true. The Bulls '96 rank pin was NOT the casualty this time and was not re-cut. (2) TOV_SIZE ALONE at its fit optimum ~2.0: the subject reaches 72, and five fives pass the Warriors while the Bulls '96 read 80. (3) MOVING AMP_MAX as a third knob (0.14 .. 0.34 across the whole grid): it buys nothing — lowering it frees Bulls headroom but costs the subject one-for-one, and no cell anywhere in the 315 reads 69 with the pins held. (4) A HARD FLOOR and the SHARPENED (c^G) feed: both refuted by recal_140 on the term's own truth column; not re-measured.
notes: THE ROUND IN ONE LINE: recal_140 gave the creation feed to the SHOOTER and left the pass-through at the small end of its flat top; recal_143 pushes that pass-through and recal_119's possession channel together to the last setting at which every one of Tomer's team pins survives, and the Suns '05 go 66 -> 68 with the 47-season fit UP in all five eras.
